text: You know that moment when you're trying to cook and your toddler won't leave the kitchen? And right now, the big tree is the one thing they can't touch. So give them their own. A magnet Christmas tree for the fridge, with Santa, a reindeer and little presents. On, off, and on again. And it's big. The tree is almost twenty inches tall. People say it keeps their toddler busy for a good chunk of the day. Only problem? Now the grown-ups want a turn. Christmas is only weeks away. Grab one for your fridge and one for grandma's. It's in the orange cart.
